title: the-aider-venv-imports-on-its-own-interpreter
intention: The aider_shim venv imports on the interpreter it was built with: pydub's audioop comes from the audioop-lts backport when Python is 3.13 or newer, and verify() goes red when a stated package is present on disk but fails to import, instead of passing on find_spec alone.
why: test_driver reds 21 teeth: the apprentice cannot drive one edit because aider will not import in its own venv, and the venv's verify read green over it
traces_to: Law 7 and Law 3 via the device's host-seam: verify() is the re-runnable half whose whole job is to go red when the venv drifts with nothing in git changing, and here it read green over a venv where aider cannot import, because find_spec measures that a file exists and not that it runs (structure measured when behaviour meant). The red at test_driver is the lived symptom: the apprentice cannot drive a single edit.
how: In cairn/devices/aider_shim/venv.py: (1) add "audioop-lts==0.2.2; python_version >= '3.13'" to the stated set, as a tuple of its own (INTERPRETER_BACKFILL) with the why spelled beside it: pydub 0.25.1 imports audioop unconditionally, and Python 3.13 removed audioop from the stdlib (PEP 594); build() installs it with the rest. (2) verify()'s probe imports every name with importlib.import_module and reports failures under a new key unimportable_required as {name: 'ExcType: message'}; ok needs it empty. find_spec stays, under missing_required. Then re-run the host-seam apply (python3 -m cairn.devices.aider_shim.venv) so the live venv gains the backport, and run test_driver.py.
falsifier: RED if: (1) verify(), pointed at a scratch venv holding a stated package whose import raises, returns ok True or does not name that package under unimportable_required; (2) the set build() installs carries no audioop-lts requirement marked python_version >= '3.13'; (3) after the apply, cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_driver.py on the live venv still reds with ModuleNotFoundError for audioop or pyaudioop. Horizon: the tester seal of the new proof plus the live verify() reading ok.
watchme: none, because verify() in cairn/devices/aider_shim/venv.py is itself the re-runnable watch over the venv, and the import-for-real probe is what this ticket adds to it
children: none, because the change is one tuple, one probe key and one helper in cairn/devices/aider_shim/venv.py
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Where does the scratch venv come from? python3 -m venv --without-pip into scratch_dir('aider_venv_fixture_'), then write site-packages/cairn_fixture_raises/__init__.py containing raise ImportError('fixture: present but broken'). (2) How is verify pointed at it? verify reads the module global VENV through python(); the tooth sets venv.VENV to the scratch path and restores it in finally, and passes the import-name list in — so verify gains a keyword import_names=None defaulting to the existing list, and the tooth passes ['cairn_fixture_raises']. (3) The aider import half will fail in the scratch venv — fine: the tooth asserts ok is False AND 'cairn_fixture_raises' is a key of unimportable_required with 'fixture: present but broken' in its value. (4) Clause 2 tooth: some entry of build's package list starts with 'audioop-lts' and contains "python_version >= '3.13'" — expose the list as packages() so build() and the tooth read one source. (5) PROVES = {ticket: {'1': tooth1, '2': tooth2}}; resolve names from venv inside each tooth.
